messages:
Ana (AE): Hey team — incoming POC with Kestrel Finance. They want a 4-week eval to validate: 1) data redaction + SSO/KMS compliance, 2) latency & throughput under their traffic pattern, 3) answer quality on 3 vertical prompt sets (accounting, reconciliation, fraud triage). Can we align on the eval harness scope, required golden examples, scoring rubric, and any enterprise blockers? @Devin @Marta @Liam

Devin (SE): Quick sketch: we'll stand up an eval harness repo and a runner that can: ingest CSV of (prompt, gold_answer, metadata), run batches against hosted and dedicated variants, compute token/latency metrics, and produce per-prompt scores + aggregate. Estimate: 5 working days to bootstrap harness + 3 days to instrument metrics for regression gates. Link: https://git.internal/rw/harness (WIP)

Marta (Sales-Eng): Good. On pricing: Kestrel asked about a temporary Dedicated trial vs hosted credits. Recommend 2-week Dedicated trial with a capped usage commit (e.g., $15k) to match their load profile. We'll include a success-based credit refund if they convert to annual. Need SE to size GPU pool for their concurrency — Devin?

Devin (SE): Need their qps and typical seq lengths. From the discovery call: peak 60 concurrent sessions, avg seq 600 tokens, spikes to 1200. For targets we should test 100% replay of a day's traffic in 2x real-time to surface queuing. Rough GPU sizing: 4x A100-like nodes with batching tuned. I can validate with perf tests.

Liam (Solution Arch): Security blockers: they've got a SOC2+ requirement and a KMS-backed key policy, plus strict retention (30 days then purge). We can support SSO + SCIM, KMS/HSM for private, and add audit log export. Need to confirm network: they want Private with VPC peering, not just hosted. Also they will insist on a data processing addendum. I'll draft the checklist.

Devin (SE): For the eval harness scoring rubric, propose multi-tier metrics: 1) correctness (exact-match / token-level F1), 2) entailment (NLI score threshold), 3) business-rule checks (regex/field validation for structured outputs), 4) latency p95. Example scoring snippet: ```scoring:
  - name: exact_match
    weight: 0.4
    threshold: 0.7
  - name: nli_semantic
    weight: 0.4
    threshold: 0.75
  - name: latency_p95_ms
    weight: 0.2
    threshold: 200
```

Marta (Sales-Eng): Those thresholds look reasonable. For commercial success gates we should require: accuracy score >= 0.78 (weighted), p95 latency <= 220ms for hosted baseline or <= 180ms on Dedicated config, and no security exceptions on the questionnaire. If any gate fails, an agreed remediation window of 2 weeks.

Ana (AE): Timeline alignment: Week 0: contract + security questionnaire in parallel. Week 1: harness setup + gather golden dataset (Kestrel to provide 500 seed prompts across verticals). Week 2: run baseline hosted tests, Week 3: run Dedicated performance tests + tuning, Week 4: finalize report + review. Is that realistic?

Devin (SE): Yes, but note golden dataset curation often slips. Recommend we provide a prompt collection template and a lightweight labeling spreadsheet. Also ask Kestrel for negative cases and ambiguous queries to test regressions. If they can't provide 500, we can seed 150 and iterate.

Liam (Solution Arch): I'll own security questionnaire responses and network diagrams. Also need Product to sign off on retention policy; looping @marta for commercial OK on trial terms.

Marta (Sales-Eng): Fine. I'll propose the 2-week Dedicated trial terms and a $15k usage cap. Also flag legal for DPA + addendum.

security-bot: Security questionnaire submitted to legal queue (ticket: SEC-4721). ETA 48h.

Ana (AE): Action items recap: 1) Devin: seed harness repo + prompt template (due EOD Tue). 2) Marta: draft trial commercial terms + credit refund language (due Wed). 3) Liam: complete security checklist + network reqs (due Wed). 4) Ana: coordinate with Kestrel to collect seed prompts and negatives. We'll sync mid-week for progress. :thumbsup:

Devin (SE): I'll push the harness skeleton and a sample scoring CSV. Expect a minimal CLI: `python run_eval.py --model host|dedicated --input seeds.csv`. Also adding a metrics dashboard export (CSV + perf graphs).

Marta (Sales-Eng): Cool. If legal stalls on DPA, we can offer a limited hosted test with no ingestion of PII and redaction applied client-side — fallback option.

Ana (AE): Thanks everyone. I'll start the kickoff with Kestrel and send calendar invites.

Devin (SE): (reaction: :eyes:) will iterate on the scoring weights once we see first run.

Liam (Solution Arch): (reaction: :rocket:)

Ana (AE): Closing note — capture all golden examples and scoring criteria in the final POC report so we have clear regression gates for post-POC onboarding.
